senses.gloss: f. (סוּם, v. סְמֵי) [tied up, hidden,] treasure.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 43:23">Targ. Gen. XLIII, 23</cite> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="M01020"><he>מַטְמוֹן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 21:20">Targ. Prov. XXI, 20</cite> (h. text <cite ref="A00825"><he>אוֹצָר</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:7">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>וס׳ יהוי וכ׳</he> let the treasure (that has been found) belong to both of them.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:5:7">Ib.</cite> <he>וס׳ עלת למלכא</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:1">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>וס׳ סלקא לבי מלכא</he> and the treasure goes to the king’s treasury; Tanḥ. Emor 6; Yalk.Ps. Ps. 727; Pesik. Zakhor, p. 74ᵇ sq.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2:7">Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ</cite> top <he>אשכח … ס׳</he> R. A. must have found a treasure (because he looks so bright); Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ <cite ref="O00689"><he>סִימָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00684"><he>סִימָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00691"><he>סִימָאתָא</he></cite>. Targ. O. Gen. l. c. ed. Berl. (v. supra).

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:19">Targ. O. Deut. XXXIII, 19</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="O00686"><he>סימא</he></cite> sing.; ed. Berl. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימַּן</he></cite>; Y. II <he>סִימָנַיָּא</he>; ed. Vien. <cite ref="O00609"><he>סִיטְמָנַיָּא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 45:3">Targ. Is. XLV, 3</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִמַן</he></cite>); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="O00689"><he>סִימָה</he></cite>.
